title: U.S. SEC to again delay 'innovation exemption' for tokenization amid Wall Street, White House concerns
summary: The SEC was ready to release at least some part of the innovation exemption alongside its now-canceled open meeting for "Reg Crypto" on Friday.

title: SEC cancels long-awaited proposal of Reg Crypto, postponing meeting without new date
summary: The first major crypto rule to be proposed by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission will have to wait a bit longer after a sudden postponement.

title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
summary: KPMG U.S. examined Tether's books and even counted its gold bars as the $180 billion USDT issuer said it completed its long-promised financial audit.

title: Forecasts for $1 million bitcoin price likely look too ambitious, key ratio suggests
summary: The thesis is that high yields on long-term U.S. Treasuries make non-yielding assets like bitcoin less attractive.

title: Trezor warns 14,000 customers after fulfilment partner suffers data breach
summary: The incident marks the first time Trezor customers' shipping addresses were exposed.
